daily-newspaper.description: Builds one newspaper issue a day from the configured sections and delivers it by email and to the e-reader.

steps.sections: Reads the configured sections and their search queries.
steps.claim: Claims today's issue, unless it was already delivered.
steps.search: Searches the web for each section.
steps.filter: Keeps only the results the issue may show.
steps.summary: Asks the language model for a short summary of the section's results.
steps.render: Renders the issue as an email and as an EPUB.
steps.email_gate: Checks the email has not been sent yet and freezes what will be sent.
steps.push_gate: Records the sent email and checks the reader does not have the issue yet.
steps.push: Queues the EPUB on the e-reader.
steps.record: Marks the day's issue as delivered.

transcribe-file.description: Turns one audio file into a transcript file with timestamps. Running it again on the same audio and model changes nothing; another model writes a second file beside the first.

steps.transcribe: Sends the audio to the speech-to-text actor and writes the transcript.

transcribe-file-he.description: Turns one audio file into a transcript file with timestamps. Running it again on the same audio and model changes nothing; another model writes a second file beside the first.

steps.transcribe: Sends the audio to the speech-to-text actor and writes the transcript.

transcript-to-reader.description: Turns one finished transcript into a book on the e-reader: a short summary first, then the transcript. Running it again on the same transcript adds no second copy.

steps.fallback: Transcribes the audio again with the Hebrew model when the English transcript came back empty.
steps.keep: Keeps the finished transcript when no second transcription is needed.
steps.pick: Picks the transcript the book is made from.
steps.summary: Asks the language model for a one- or two-line summary and a one-word topic.
steps.render: Makes the book, titled with the recording's date and topic, right to left for Hebrew.
steps.push: Uploads the book to the e-reader library and queues it for the device.

discord-message-to-library.description: Files a Discord message in the library as a Markdown document.

steps.read: Reads the whole message with the bot that saw it.
steps.render: Writes the message as a Markdown page.
steps.push: Adds the page to the library as a private document.

repodocs-sync.description: Pushes the specs, plans, delivery summaries, designs and devague files of every repo on this machine to the library, sending only what changed since the last run.

steps.sync: Sends each changed file, draft and deletion to the library and counts them.
